title: Silent Night
_about: PROPOSED for owner review. Tune STILLE NACHT (Gruber), checked note for note against the public-domain Mutopia Project score, transposed from B-flat to C. 6/8 time, counted here as 3 quarter-note beats per bar. The melody uses 11 different notes (Do up to high Fa).

parts.bells: Do/3 | Do/3 | Sol/3 | Do/3 | Fa/3 | Do/3 | Fa/3 | Do/3 | Sol/3 | Do/3 | Do/3 | -/3

_arrangements: No 2-phone version: the melody needs 11 different notes and two phones hold only 8, so a 2-phone version would have to change the tune. 3 and 4 phones add 'bells': a low chord note (Do, Fa or Sol) on the first beat of each bar. In the 4-phone version phone D rings those, plus the last notes of the song.
